papers.title: Molten pool behavior and its mechanism during selective laser melting of polyamide 6 powder: single track simulation and experiments

corresponding_authors.name: Jinzhe Wu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Biomedical Engineering, Anhui Medical University, Hefei, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文研究聚合物选区激光熔化中的熔池行为，与生物医学金属植入物的LPBF制造、应力遮挡、疲劳性能等方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on polymer SLM (polyamide 6) with no biomedical implant context, no LPBF metal fabrication, no stress shielding or fatigue analysis, and no mechanical testing relevant to osseointegration or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究聚酰胺6粉末选区激光熔化中熔池行为及其机制
summary_zh.method: 单道次模拟与实验相结合分析熔池动态
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数对熔池尺寸和形貌的影响规律
summary_zh.validation: 通过单道次实验验证模拟结果

summary_en.motivation: To understand the molten pool behavior and its underlying mechanisms during selective laser melting of polyamide 6 powder.
summary_en.method: Combined single-track simulation and experimental observation to analyze molten pool dynamics.
summary_en.result: Revealed the influence of processing parameters on molten pool dimensions and morphology.
summary_en.validation: Validated simulation results with single-track experiments.

papers.title: APPLICATION OF BIOPRINTING IN CONTEMPORARY MEDICINE (REVIEW)
papers.abstract: 3D printing is an advanced recent technology, which can be a revolutionary alternative with a variety of applications in the transplant and healthcare industry in general. 3D printing research is investigated in various fields within the healthcare industry; some of which are discussed in this article. 3D printing of human tissue and organs can revolutionize the healthcare industry by extending the average life expectancy and greatly improving the quality of life for millions of people. Organ recipients will no longer have to wait months or years for a donor with the correct blood type, organ transplant rejection will be abolished, illegal human trafficking for organ harvesting can be minimized, and war and accident amputees can once again gain full mobility. 3D Bioprinting may have unprecedented consequences on regenerative medicine and quality of life while minimizing social and legal issues which currently surround human embryo techniques.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是一篇关于生物打印在当代医学中应用的综述，没有涉及AI或自主决策，与AI生物打印方向相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a broad review of bioprinting applications without any AI integration, experimental validation, or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述生物打印在再生医学中的潜力与应用
summary_zh.method: 文献综述，总结3D生物打印技术及其医学应用
summary_zh.result: 生物打印有望革命性改变移植医学，但AI未涉及

summary_en.motivation: This review explores the potential of 3D bioprinting to revolutionize regenerative medicine and organ transplantation.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive literature review summarizing current bioprinting technologies, materials, and medical applications.
summary_en.result: Bioprinting offers promise for addressing organ shortage and transplant rejection, but AI integration is not discussed.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a review article.
